title: Push Feature Branch
description: Our view at the git adapter of integration: the input of 1 push job of a feature branch, outside the pass (A28, A33).

feature_id.description: The feature whose branch is pushed; the subject of the push job.

seen_remote_tip.description: Optional. features.seen_remote_tip, the remote tip that fleetd last saw. A push that rewrites uses --force-with-lease on it; absent for the first push of the branch.
